notes: Thunderbird for Android (formerly K-9 Mail), importing the Bolt design system from the included components build. :ui:bolt holds its commonMain previews; workingDirectory makes components the Gradle root. The upstream now uses com.android.kotlin.multiplatform.library and supplies withHostTest { isIncludeAndroidResources = true }. Set composePreview.kmpAndroidRobolectric=true to select that Android lane: renderer=android controls pipeline setup but does not select the plugin backend for KMP modules. The default Desktop graph upgrades upstream Material 3 1.9.0 to the renderer's 1.11.0-alpha07 while retaining upstream Foundation 1.12.1, failing 42 previews with AbstractMethodError in OutlinedTextFieldDefaults/CustomStyle.applyStyle. The Android lane preserves upstream Compose dependencies; validated with 357 selected previews producing 409 PNGs (parameter rows included) and no error sidecars. Requires the plugin release carrying the composePreview.kmpAndroidRobolectric Gradle property (compose-ai-tools#5703). previewAnnotations names AndroidX PreviewLightDark and Bolt's PreviewDevices, PreviewDevicesWithBackground and PreviewLightDarkLandscape multipreviews. The inventory omits repeated function names (Preview and IconPreview) that cannot be joined unambiguously. The existing seven exclusions remain: BadgeIcon, FilledNewMailBadge and FilledUnreadMailBadge previews lack the ThemeSizes CompositionLocal, and RemoteImagePreview requires a Coil network fetcher absent from the standalone runtime. The spec declares all six PreviewDevices widths (360, 411, 673, 891, 1280, 1920), avoiding duplicate size axes for responsive templates. Apache-2.0.
